name: Betrayal from Within marks Kuz's Skull at Kuz's own spawn
contract: Quest 879 'Betrayal from Within' (Camp Taurajo, Barrens) wants Nak, Kuz and Lok Orcbane's skulls. Until rev_20261027_84_coa_quest_879_kuz_skull_poi the Kuz's Skull marker (quest_poi id 0, ObjectiveIndex 4) sat at (-3764, -1833), about 132 yards from Kuz's own spawn (creature.sql guid 14383: -3814.72, -1955.13, map 1), well outside the Razormane camp the pin pointed at (#7721). This case asks the server for 879's points with the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE itself, independently computing Kuz's rounded spawn coordinates as the expected pin.
